mcqs.question: Under the Jeevan Daan organ donation initiative, what record was achieved in Andhra Pradesh in 2025?
mcqs.explanation: Andhra Pradesh retrieved 301 organs from 93 brain-dead donors in 2025, the highest number since bifurcation. The figure of 1,296 organs from 403 donors refers to the period since 2015, not 2025 alone.
